justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic figure rendered schematically and both include a small circular/disc element and curving linear motifs, but these are among the most universal of motifs. A shows a tiny stick figure with raised arms placed beside a long horizontal wavy serpent on an open field, while B is a frontal/rear monumental figure with a face and a body covered in nested relief motifs (rings, arcs, bands) — no shared composition, posture, or motif combination.
